name: Fluorine-free wetting agent
problem: PFAS bans hit fluorosurfactants that coatings, inks and electronics need for wetting
design: Fluorine-free surfactant that wets as well as a fluorosurfactant

market.what: fluorosurfactants for wetting/leveling/anti-crater in coatings, inks, adhesives, electronics, cleaners, oilfield; world; excl. foam, PFAS polymerization aids, textile repellents
market.method: non-foam wetting uses = 63% of sales (GMI split); GMI $1.5B x 63% = $945M, report cluster ~$0.70B (Fortune, MRFR, Straits, FactMR) x 63% = $440M, avg $690M; bottom-up 12-15 kt capacity x 85% use x ~60% x ~$100/kg ≈ $700M

value.logic: buyers pay ~$100/kg (China bulk $85-250) for fluoro vs ~$5-15/kg hydrocarbon wetters (est.) for the last 5-10 mN/m (fluoro 15-20, trisiloxane 20-25, hydrocarbon 25-38); ~6 kt/yr x ~$85/kg paid for function ≈ $500M kept without PFAS; silicone/hydrocarbon swaps need higher dose and fail some uses (Evonik)
value.revenue_logic: 1% of PFAS-free slip/leveling additive market ~$1.5B in 2033 ($849M 2026 at 8.9%/yr) ≈ $15M ≈ 250 t/yr x $60/kg; check: DIC targets ¥5B (~$33M) for Megaface EFS by FY2030
value.margin_logic: specialty additive used at 0.05-0.5% dose, priced on function; toll-made by CRO/CMO; lower if licensed through an additive house

trend.drivers: fluoro sales only +2.4%/yr but PFAS-free wetting/leveling +6-9%/yr; Chemours Capstone discontinued early 2025; 3M PFAS exit end-2025; EU PFHxA limits on consumer mixtures from Oct 2026; EU universal PFAS restriction; MN/ME product bans
trend.deadline: EU universal PFAS restriction: SEAC final opinion end-2026, then Commission vote; MN and ME bans on all PFAS products 1 Jan 2032

competition.notes: No funded startup found making a drop-in fluoro-free wetting agent; biosurfactant startups target cleaning. Strongest: DIC EFS (2023, ¥5B target FY2030), Evonik/BYK/Momentive silicone swaps. Bristol/Hirosaki 'hedgehog' C/Si surfactants near PFAS surface tension, working with French and Chinese firms

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: branched 'hedgehog' hydrocarbon or trisiloxane-hydrocarbon hybrid from catalog alcohols/siloxanes; 3 variants + catalog controls (Surfynol, trisiloxane, a fluoro benchmark)
lab.test: static surface tension ASTM D1331 (Wilhelmy/du Noüy); dynamic surface tension by bubble pressure (10 ms-10 s); contact angle on PE/PTFE/oily steel; crater and leveling drawdowns on oil-contaminated panels in 2 waterborne coatings; university colloid lab or coatings CRO
lab.logic: CRO 5-6 wk + tests/formulation 4 wk; 3 x $6k CRO = $18k + contact angle ~€450/sample x 8 ≈ $4k + surface tension runs ~$2k + drawdowns/formulation ~$6k

sale.gates: formulator trials in each paint/ink 6-18 mo (est.); chip and display fabs 1 to several yrs per layer (SIA); TSCA PMN averaged 665 days in 2025, so use LVE (≤10 t/yr) or polymer exemption; REACH none <1 t/yr, 1-10 t fee €2,078 plus data
